name: analysis: concatenate two datasets and report what happened
description: Tier 3, live Galaxy. The harness stages cat1's own test inputs into a history; the agent is told the goal and the tool, never the test's parameters, so parameterising the tool from its description is what is measured. Graded three ways: the job reached ok, the output matches the tool test's expectation under its declared comparison, and the reply does not claim work that failed.
inputs: Concatenate the two BED datasets in this history into one, using the Concatenate datasets tool, then tell me how many lines the result has.
